title: Baked Zucchini Noodles with Mushrooms, Creamy Marinara & Parmesan

steps.text: Wash, dry, and trim zucchini; use a julienne (or regular) peeler, make noodles. Divide noodles and mushrooms between two baking sheet pans. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until tender, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place marinara sauce and cream in a medium saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Once simmering, remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide zucchini noodles and mushrooms between plates or bowls; top with sauce and Parmesan. Enjoy!
